Buy Bluetti in Kenya with confidence

Bluetti power stations provide quiet, rechargeable backup power for homes, businesses, travel and off-grid use. Choose a compact unit for essential electronics or a higher-capacity AC or EP series system for demanding home backup requirements.

Batteriq helps customers across Kenya choose compatible Bluetti power stations, solar panels and expansion batteries. We accept M-Pesa and arrange delivery in Nairobi and nationwide shipping.

Bluetti Kenya frequently asked questions

Is Batteriq a Bluetti dealer in Kenya?

Yes. Batteriq supplies genuine Bluetti products in Kenya and provides local pre-sale and after-sales support.

Can I pay for a Bluetti power station with M-Pesa?

Yes. M-Pesa payment is available for Bluetti purchases through Batteriq.

Do you deliver Bluetti products outside Nairobi?

Yes. We arrange nationwide delivery across Kenya, with Nairobi delivery options available.

Which BLUETTI power station suits a Kenyan home?

It depends on what you run. The Premium and smaller AC models cover Wi-Fi, lights and electronics; larger AC models and the Homestar home systems cover a fridge and longer outages. Prices start from KES 27,500 for the AC series. Send us your appliance list on WhatsApp and we will size it.

Are BLUETTI AC300 and AC500 sold with batteries?

The AC300 and AC500 are modular power units: they need at least one BLUETTI B-series battery to run, and the battery is sold separately. Ask us on WhatsApp which battery and how many suit your needs.

What warranty do BLUETTI products have?

Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty. Keep your Batteriq receipt as proof of purchase, and contact us for any warranty support.

About BLUETTI in Kenya

Batteriq is an authorised BLUETTI dealer in Kenya. BLUETTI makes LFP-battery power stations, home backup systems, expansion batteries and solar panels. Here is the range we stock, with live prices.

Read moreShow less

AC series (7, from KES 27,500): portable power stations for home backup and travel — for example the BLUETTI AC2P. Premium series (3, from KES 30,500): compact stations for essentials — for example the BLUETTI Premium 30 V2. Homestar and home systems (5, from KES 99,000): residential backup, inverters and home batteries — for example the BLUETTI Homestar 3 Solution. B-series batteries (1, from KES 91,999): expansion batteries for compatible stations — for example the BLUETTI B300S Extra Battery. PV solar panels (3, from KES 16,000): panels for solar charging — for example the BLUETTI PV100 Solar Panel 100W.

All 10 BLUETTI power stations we stock list an LFP battery, the chemistry that keeps most of its capacity after thousands of charge cycles. Several models grow with you: modular units such as the AC300 and AC500 run on separate B-series batteries (sold separately), so you can start with one battery and add more for longer backup. For everyday outages, a smaller AC or Premium model covers Wi-Fi, lights and a TV; for a fridge and longer blackouts, look at the larger AC models and the Homestar home systems.

Pair a station with solar panels for daytime charging, or compare models on our comparison page. Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty. Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.
